name: Intercessory Prayer
overview: Intercessory prayer is a powerful biblical practice where believers stand in the gap for others, as demonstrated by Job who prayed for his friends and received God's abundant blessing (Job 42:10). Scripture reveals the necessity of intercessors, with Isaiah highlighting God's wonder at the lack of such prayer and His sustaining righteousness (Isaiah 59:16), while also calling watchmen to persistent prayer on behalf of Jerusalem (Isaiah 62:6). Jesus affirms the authority and promise of united, faith-filled prayer, assuring that what is asked in agreement will be granted by the Father (Matthew 18:19), and that abiding in Him enables believers to ask according to His will with confident expectation (John 15:7; Matthew 21:22).
